description: Comprehensive example demonstrating all available fee structure fields and capabilities

fees.specialRules: Example platform demonstrating all available fee structure capabilities. ISA: 0.30% (capped £250). SIPP: 0.25% + £120 annual SIPP fee (capped £300). GIA: £2.99/month fixed fee. JISA: 0% platform fee, exempt from minimum, capped £50. JSIPP: 0% platform fee (exempt). Minimum £5/month applies to ISA/SIPP/GIA only (not JISA). Per-adult fee cap aggregation.
Basic plan: £5.99/month flat fee. Free regular investing. £5.99 per trade for shares/ETFs.

fieldDescriptions.platformFeeLevel: Where percentage fee applies: 'platform_level' (entire portfolio) or 'account_level' (per account)
fieldDescriptions.fixedPlatformFee: Fixed monthly fee in GBP (annualized by multiplying by 12)
fieldDescriptions.fixedPlatformFeeLevel: Where fixed fee applies: 'platform_level' (once per customer) or 'account_level' (per account)
fieldDescriptions.minimumPlatformFee: Minimum monthly platform fee in GBP (annualized by multiplying by 12)
fieldDescriptions.platformFeeExemptAccountTypes: Array of account types that pay £0 platform fee (e.g., ['JSIPP'] for Fidelity)
fieldDescriptions.minimumFeeExemptAccountTypes: Array of account types excluded from minimum fee calculation (e.g., ['JISA'] for Vanguard)
fieldDescriptions.platformFeeOverridesByAccountType: Object mapping account types to specific percentage fees (e.g., {'ISA': 0.30, 'SIPP': 0.25})
fieldDescriptions.fixedFeeOverridesByAccountType: Object mapping account types to specific fixed monthly fees (e.g., {'ISA': 4.99, 'GIA': 0})
fieldDescriptions.feeCaps: Maximum annual platform fee per account type. Set to 0 for no cap.
fieldDescriptions.feeCaps.level: 'platform_level' (single cap across portfolio) or 'account_level' (cap per adult, children linked)
fieldDescriptions.sippFees: SIPP-specific annual charges (drawdown, crystallisation, general annual fee)
fieldDescriptions.specialRules: Human-readable summary of fee rules for display

calculationNotes.adultAggregation: When feeCaps.level = 'account_level', fees are calculated per adult. Children's accounts are linked to an adult and included in that adult's fee calculation.
calculationNotes.exemptions: platformFeeExemptAccountTypes bypasses all platform fee logic for specified accounts (always £0).
calculationNotes.overrides: platformFeeOverridesByAccountType takes precedence over platformFeePercent for specific account types.
calculationNotes.minimumLogic: Minimum fee is only applied if calculated platform fee is below the minimum threshold. Exempt account types never trigger minimum.
calculationNotes.capLogic: Fee caps are applied after all other calculations (percentage, fixed, minimum). Account-level caps aggregate adult + linked children before capping.
